items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: we all stuck, the three guys, we three just -- one without the other. We all just stuck together.

ctx.x: He got with the -- funny thing about that, I think he ate something with poison that sit back on him. He was a fine fellow, very fine fellow. Only, you know, thing about those fellows, when we were kids, young guys coming up, they always liked to see us make progress. They say, when you got to the folks you can play something. Well, what do you want to play? We say, oh, we play so and so, so (Simon and and so. All right. We go in there, sit in and play, myself and Cecil Irwin.

And when we graduated from grammar school and from high school, we were always supposed to go to Atlanta, Georgia, to go to the Morehouse University because they had a big, beautiful -- they had a mixed curriculum there for students. And he went to Morehouse, and I went to Wilberforce. So they could --
